newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Mid East veg oil market to expand 3.0-4.0 pct/yr.
newsitem.headline: Mid East veg oil market to expand 3.0-4.0 pct/yr.

text.p: The Middle East edible oils and vegetable fats market is forecast to expand by 3.0-4.0 percent over the next few years from the 2.29 million tonnes, now an official of the Savola Co of Saudi Arabia said on Friday.
"We can expect the market to grow by some 3.0-4.0 percent per annum in volume terms," Abdulraouf Mannaa, senior executive vice-president of Savola, said at an edible oil markets meeting in Singapore.
"And this is without any allowances for any liberalisation or more favourable conditions in Iran or Iraq," he said.
Savola, which is traded on the Saudi stock market, is the country's biggest food group and the country's main supplier of cooking oil.
Corn oil from the U.S. and palm oil from Asia are the most popular oils used in Saudi Arabia.
